newsitem.title: TURKEY: Turk Netas-Aselsan in 167.66 mln DM military deal.
newsitem.headline: Turk Netas-Aselsan in 167.66 mln DM military deal.

text.p: An international consortium led by Turkish telecommunications equipment producer Netas Northern Electric and military electronics producer Aselsan won a 167.66 million German mark military contract in Turkey, the companies said in separate statements.
The five-year project named TASMUS was awarded by the Turkish Defense Ministry and aims to set up a system to modernise the communications infrastructre of the Turkish army.
Netas, owned 51.85 percent by Northern Telecom Int. said in a statement sent to the Istanbul Stock Exchange that it would carry out a 44-million-mark part of the project.
Also in the consortium were Savronik, Marconi SpA, Page, Mercedes, Makyal and Havelsan.
Aselsan said TASMUS was a rapidly deployable, reliable, secure, mobile, multi-channel communications system compatible with the military standards.
